note: USACE Harlan County Lake park at the east end of the lake by the dam, just east of North Shore Marina, Republican City. Basic undesignated camping: pick a spot with a fire ring and picnic table among the trees; pay at the self-pay vault. Restrooms, playground and a reservable group shelter. Corps office 308-799-2105. --Claude
summary: USACE campgrounds page (2023 capture; live page 403) gives Gremlin Cove $14/night, basic first-come camping at spots with a fire ring and table, self-pay. RIDB lists no campsites (only the day-use group shelter). Stored pin is on North Shore Marina's docks - move ~230 m east to the park. Sites sit behind the park loop road or above a sandy drawdown flat: lakefront -> lakeview.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 40.0850,-99.2175 is on the North Shore Marina boat docks (RIDB 248159 North Shore Marina is 40.0844,-99.2178). The Gremlin Cove camping area is the wooded park east of the cove, centre ~40.0849,-99.2148 (RIDB 248161 at 40.08519,-99.21430). ~230 m, but it is on another facility, so move it.

WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview: the camping spurs are in the treed park; on the west the park loop road runs between them and the rip-rap bank of the marina cove (~40-70 m to water), on the south a park road and then an open sand/grass flat run to a drawdown waterline 150-250 m away. Road between every visible site and the water = *view at best; no per-site map exists.

FEES: $14 is from the March 2023 Wayback capture of the USACE page (the live page refused plain HTTP with 403); no newer dated rate found. The fee list's other rows: Hunter Cove $18-24, Methodist Cove $18-28, North and South Outlet and Cedar Point $12.

HOOKUPS: the old note's 'some electric hookups available' is not supported - USACE calls Gremlin Cove one of the 'more basic' parks (utilities are named only for Methodist Cove and Hunter Cove), and rec.gov's only electric product here is the group shelter. Removed from the note; electric left unwritten rather than 0 since the page does not say 'no electric'.

SEASON year_round false and facilities (vault toilets, potable water) are derived from the old note and unverified; Good Sam (directory) gives May 1 - Sep 30. Left alone. Imagery shows two small restroom buildings.

WEBSITE https://www.recreation.gov/camping/gateways/264 is the lake gateway (fine; the USACE page is better but blocks bots). PHONE 308-799-2105 matches the USACE page ('call the Corps of Engineers office at 308-799-2105').

SAND: an open sand flat lies south of the park road toward the drawn-down lake; nothing says camping is on it, and the designated spots (fire ring + table) are among the trees on firm ground. Not a sand-rule candidate on present evidence.
LEADS: the USACE page names Cedar Point and North Outlet parks ($12, basic) - neither is in the DB by name (South Outlet 2762, Hunter Cove 2757, Methodist Cove 2758 are).
